# Real sensor recordings (Sensor Lab, M9) — C owns this folder

**Synthetic traces do not live here.** The synthetic scenarios and their replay CSVs are generated by
`pnpm --filter @najda/detector traces` into `packages/detector/traces/` (with `manifest.json`); the app bundles a
verbatim copy of a few of them (`apps/mobile/scripts/bundle-traces.ts`).

This folder is for **real recordings** made with the Sensor Lab on the demo phones (docs/13 §6.3 and §7):

- Format: exactly the detector's trace format, `t_ms,ax,ay,az,gx,gy,gz,speed_kmh` (g, deg/s, ms; `speed_kmh` only
  on rows where a GPS fix arrived). A real trace replays with no code change.
- Name: `<scenario>_<phone>_<yyyymmdd-hhmm>.csv`, plus a first comment line `# scenario, mount, vehicle, road,
  phone model, Android version` (lines starting with `#` are ignored by `parseCsv`).
- **Never stage a crash.** Negatives and low-speed manoeuvres only, in a closed, legal, safe area, with a passenger
  operating the phone. Strip GPS coordinates before sharing (only speed is kept by the format anyway).
- Tune on a training set, report on a separate set, and log any `PARAMS` change in `DECISIONS.md` with the evidence.
